en-US.name: Nanobeasts Pro Lifetime
en-US.description: Unlock Nanobeasts Pro forever with one payment.

review_information.notes: Nanobeasts Pro lifetime access is a non-consumable one-time purchase. It unlocks the existing premium entitlement permanently after the built-in free onboarding experience, with no trial or recurring billing. No account or sign-in is required. Restore Purchases is available on the paywall and saved-journey screen. The Apple Watch companion receives the iPhone's Premium access. Monthly/yearly purchases remain supported for existing customers.
